_comment: Golden snapshot for the M1 exit gate test. Captures expected minimum node/edge counts and a subset of USR-keyed nodes from the m1_5file fixture (shapes.cpp + utils.cpp + broken.cpp). Counts are lower-bounds; the test asserts >= these values. USR strings are extracted by running Phase 1 against the fixture with a known libclang version; re-run generate_golden.sh when the fixture changes.
